records.title: ANTYODAYA ANNA YOJANA
details: CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

Sir, as I have already told क उसका overall equalization करना है,
क्यक अगर 5 लोग ह, तब भी हम 35 kg देते ह, एक व्यिक्त है, तब भी 35 kg देते ह। आज ICMR
क स्टडी के अनुसार Dietary Guidelines for Indians, 2024, issued by the National Institute of
Nutrition, under ICMR, and the findings of the Household Consumption Expenditure Survey
(HCES), वह स्टडी करके हमने pre-legislative consultation शुरू कया है। उसके आधार पर हम
final decision लेने जा रहे ह। हम जो final decision लगे, वह भी हमारे पास फ़ीडबैक मे आया है।

records.title: First Mile Connectivity projects
details: Since, August, 2019, CIL has identified additional 72 First Mile Connectivity (FMC) projects of 837.5 MTY Capacity. Out of these 72 projects, 15 projects of 200.5 MTY have been commissioned. Thus, as on date, total 35 FMC projects have been commissioned and are functional.
